name: Huatuo-26M
description: Huatuo-26M is a large-scale Chinese medical question answering dataset containing 26 million QA pairs. It is designed to benchmark retrieval and generation approaches in medical QA, and to facilitate improvements in pre-trained language models and retrieval-augmented generation methods for medical applications.
reputation: A very large Chinese medical QA dataset that has been used in medical NLP and retrieval-augmented generation research, though it is less standardized than long-running public benchmarks.
notes: Largest medical QA dataset with 26 million pairs; challenging for existing models; useful for zero-shot training, retrieval-augmented generation, and continued pre-training.
